title: VOLE LANGUAGE — listen · speak · sing · write form language. paint is the remainder. the vole shows the learning.
primal: fieldMouse — edge ingestion. the student at the lip of the field.
thesis: Language is not a thing you download. It is four verbs braided. Listen takes the world in. Speak sends a mark back. Sing plays the mark so it can be remembered. Write freezes the mark so a stranger can hear it later. Paint is the remainder — a mark that is not yet a letter. When the four have been practiced once, language appears. The vole shows that appearing. It does not invent the organs. It walks between them.

face_1.what: the world enters. no mark yet. just intake.

face_2.what: a mark goes out. someone could answer.

face_3.what: the mark stays. a stranger can hear it later.

jester.what: speech that plays. melody is how memory holds a sentence.

remainder.what: a mark that is not yet a letter. the leftover that becomes writing.

fourth.what: the braid. not a fifth verb. the mix of the four.

how_they_form_language.rule: you cannot send a mark you have not taken in. first ear, then mouth.
pitch and repeat make a spoken mark memorable. song is speech with a handle.
a sung mark that must survive the singer becomes a glyph.
writing is only language if someone later listens to it. the loop closes.
art is the remainder. cave painting came before alphabet. the vole still paints when the letter is not ready.

vole_shows_the_learning.who: the vole. smaller than chip. closer to the dirt than Berry. fieldMouse at the edge.
vole_shows_the_learning.job: practice one verb per beat. keep a lexicon. when all four faces have a mark, say the sentence out loud at the fire.
vole_shows_the_learning.confirm: language has formed when a stranger can listen to a written mark and answer. until then the vole is still learning.

berry_at_the_fire: the vole is at the lip of the field. it listened. it said a small thing. it sang so it would not forget. it wrote a mark in the dirt. that braid is language. i did not teach it a word. i watched the four verbs meet. the painting is the leftover — the letter that is not ready yet. that is also language, just younger.
next: do not hunt a new language. let the vole walk another π cycle. if a stranger answers a written mark, the confirm is MOVED.
